name: Prosciutto-Wrapped Chicken with Spicy Spaghetti Squash "Aglio e Olio"

instructions.primary_message: Preheat oven to 260°C (500°F) and place rack in the center position. Line a baking sheet pan with aluminum foil to make cleanup easier (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium spaghetti squash
1 lemon
½ small bunch Italian (flat-leaf) parsley

instructions.primary_message: Trim spaghetti squash, then halve lengthwise, and scrape out the seeds. Rub the inside of the squash with oil and season with salt. Arrange halves, cut-side down, on the baking sheet.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tsp extra virgin olive oil
¼ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place squash in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tender, so a knife can easily pierce through the flesh, 20-25 minutes.

Meanwhile, holding a knife parallel to the cutting board, cut the chicken in half horizontally to form thin cutlets. Season both sides with salt and pepper, then wrap each cutlet with two slices of prosciutto. Set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
⅓ kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¼ tsp salt
¼ tsp black pepper
4 slices prosciutto

instructions.primary_message: When the squash has about 10 minutes left in the oven, preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.

Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add cutlets and pan-fry until prosciutto is crisp and chicken is cooked through, 3-4 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with aluminum foil. (Reserve skillet for later use.)
Remove squash from the oven and allow to cool slightly, about 5 minutes.
While the squash is cooling, using a clean cutting board, shave parsley leaves off the stems; discard stems and roughly chop the leaves. Place in a small bowl and set aside.
Cut half of the lemon into wedges and set aside for serving. (Reserve remaining lemon for later use.)
Return skillet to medium heat, add more oil, and swirl to coat the bottom. Add garlic and crushed red pepper; cook, stirring frequently, until fragrant, about 1 minute.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
½ tsp crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Juice reserved lemon into the skillet, stir to combine the lemon-garlic sauce, and remove from heat.

Scrape the inside of the squash with a fork to separate into spaghetti-like strands (use an oven mitt or towel to hold it with your other hand). Add to the skillet with the lemon-garlic sauce, along with the parsley, and gently toss. Remove from heat.
Divide chicken and squash between plates. Serve with lemon wedges for squeezing over the chicken and enjoy!
